components.name: Arrival Row
components.description: Fixed-slot row: number, date, water mark, species, location. The unit of the whole board.
components.html: 22412 Sep 2026Kakap MerahRed snapperPulau Abang
components.css: .ds-arr-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 96px 26px minmax(0, 340px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 18px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #243040); background: var(--board, #0F151C); color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-arr-row:hover { background: var(--plate, #151D27); } .ds-arr-no { font-family: 'Doto', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); line-height: 1; } .ds-arr-date { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--salt, #4FC3D9); } .ds-wmark svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-arr-name b { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 92%; } .ds-arr-name i { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #A3B4C4); } .ds-arr-loc { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2, #A3B4C4); }

components.name: LED Total
components.description: The monumental amber lifetime total with dim ghost cells behind it.
components.css: .ds-led { display: inline-grid; font-family: 'Doto', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); font-size: clamp(110px, 17vw, 264px); line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-led::before { content: attr(data-ghost); grid-area: 1 / 1; justify-self: end; color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); opacity: 0.1; } .ds-led > span { grid-area: 1 / 1; justify-self: end; }

components.name: Board Cell
components.description: Header cell with uppercase label and Doto numeral; cells are divided by a left hairline.
components.css: .ds-cell { padding: 14px 20px 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #243040); color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-cell-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #A3B4C4); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-cell-num { font-family: 'Doto', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); }

components.name: Water Split Bar
components.description: Salt as solid aqua, fresh as hatched green, so the split reads without colour.
components.css: .ds-water-bar { display: flex; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--ground, #090D12); } .ds-salt { background: var(--salt, #4FC3D9); } .ds-fresh { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--fresh, #8FD16B) 0 2px, var(--board, #0F151C) 2px 5px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--fresh, #8FD16B); }

components.name: Time-of-Day Slot
components.description: Filter row: name, amber fill track, LED count.
components.css: .ds-tod-slot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) 40px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 4px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #243040); cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); text-align: left; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tod-slot:hover { background: var(--plate, #151D27); } .ds-tod-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tod-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tod-track { height: 10px; background: var(--ground, #090D12); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tod-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--amber, #FFB23E); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-tod-count { font-family: 'Doto', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-align: right; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid amber submit; the outline variant is the owner edit action.
components.css: .ds-submit-btn { width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: var(--amber, #FFB23E); color: var(--on-amber, #0B0F14); border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-submit-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-submit-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-submit-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-submit-btn:disabled { background: var(--raise, #1B2632); color: var(--ink-3, #8093A6); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Owner edit action; coral border and text for delete.
components.css: .ds-outline-btn { padding: 8px 16px; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-outline-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,178,62,0.14); } .ds-outline-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Ground-filled well with rule-strong stroke and amber focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--ink-2, #A3B4C4); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14.5px; background: var(--ground, #090D12); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #354456); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #8093A6); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #8093A6); }

components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 60px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-2, #A3B4C4); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 92%; position: relative; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--amber, #FFB23E); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink, #E9EEF3); } .ds-nav-item.active { color: var(--amber, #FFB23E); } .ds-nav-item.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #FFB23E); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

narrative.overview:
Every fish Del has caught is an arrival: numbered, dated and posted on one dark board, like a ferry-terminal arrivals board in the Riau Islands. The app reads as a single board with fixed slots, not a grid of stat cards. Panels are matte, separated by hairline rules, and never blurred or shadowed. It is dark-only and carries no traditional or nautical ornament.

One signal carries the whole system: LED amber. Numerals are dot-matrix (Doto) and everything else is Archivo, a variable-width grotesque squeezed narrow for headings and left at normal width for reading. Water type is never colour alone: saltwater is aqua with a wave mark, freshwater is leaf green with a drop mark and diagonal hatch. The one warm object on the page is Del's illustrated portrait on a cream plate.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed-slot rows: number, date, water mark, species, location, always in the same columns.
The monumental amber LED total with dim ghost cells (8888) behind it.
Hairline rules and tonal steps for depth; no blur, no panel shadows.
Amber is the single signal; aqua and green mean water type only.
Numerals in Doto dot-matrix; text in Archivo.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent. If something needs emphasis, it goes amber or it goes ink; it does not get a new hue.

rules.name: The Shape Carries It Rule
rules.body: Salt and fresh are always paired with their mark (wave, drop, hatch). Colour alone never states water type.

rules.name: The Ink Line Rule
rules.body: The cumulative line on charts is neutral ink, dashed, so it never competes with amber bars.

rules.name: The Dots Are Numbers Rule
rules.body: Doto sets numerals only. Words, dates, names and units are Archivo.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is on the body so counts and dates hold their slots.

rules.name: The Eleven Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text under 11px; chart axis text is the only 11px.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Panels, rows and cells are separated by rules and tone, never by shadow or blur.

dos: Do keep every panel on Board with a 1px rule border and 4px corners.
Do post lists as fixed-slot rows with hairline dividers, not cards.
Do set every numeral in Doto and everything else in Archivo.
Do pair salt with the wave mark and fresh with the drop mark and hatch.
Do keep amber to the one signal role and use ink for anything else that needs weight.
Do keep functional text at 11px or above and ink-3 as the dimmest readable text.
donts: Don't add blur, glass, or drop shadows to panels, rows or cells.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use water colours for anything but water type.
Don't use light surfaces; the only warm light plate is the portrait.
Don't put Doto on words, names or dates.
Don't lay stats out as a grid of separate cards; extend the board's cells and rows.
